title: Slice 6 and the rest: non-AI quick actions, revise, readiness

closing_checks.a_revision_applies_and_restores: pass at actions level on a verified-hours fixture; the browser witnessed the blocked path because every variant on the real trip is provisional

ported_behaviours.checklist_status: empty; all 14 portable behaviours are asserted below Streamlit
ported_behaviours.note: S6 can delete views/, app.py and ui/ without coverage dipping. What remains is the parity gate itself and artifact 029's three genuinely-UI tests.

api.interpret_revision_note: Constrained GenAI revision is deferred past the pilot, so the React surface never calls it even though the transport allows it.

copy.note: Only the readiness summary counts needed new labels. Every other string both screens use already existed.

consolidation.why: three screens had begun to diverge: places, optimize and revise each carried their own localName with a different signature
consolidation.rule: a consequence or plan row must name a place, never a truncated place_id

live_walkthrough.database: copy of data/tourist.sqlite3, never the original
live_walkthrough.apply_blocked_because: every variant on the real trip is provisional (opening evidence missing) and apply_revision requires ready and valid

defects_found_and_fixed: expected_authority holds a stable code and was rendered raw, so the board read 'Confirm with: attraction_operator'; it now resolves through the catalogue with a literal fallback for owner-entered text

pre_existing_gap_recorded_not_fixed.what: revision.py builds assumption codes with the value interpolated, e.g. WALKING_MINUTES_PER_LEG_SET_TO_14
pre_existing_gap_recorded_not_fixed.consequence: no static catalogue entry can exist, so the assumptions line renders as the documented visible-machine-output fallback
pre_existing_gap_recorded_not_fixed.why_not_fixed: changing how a locked domain module names assumptions is outside S5 and needs its own decision
